A Slip Of A Thing

Written by Jim Murray and transcribed from Tara Breen and Padriag Rynne’s album “Nasc.”

A Slip Of A Thing, X:2

Here’s a close transcription of Tara Breen’s playing in the above clip. I’d say it’s in F (not Dm as originally posted here).

And Padraig Rynne does a tasty little variation in 2nd bar of the last line:
GAG GFD FGA|~B3 AGF Gfe|d3 dcA cAF|GBA CDF BAG||

↳ Posted by gimpy on March 15th, 2022.

A Slip Of A Thing, X:3

I learned this tune in F from the playing of Tara Breen, but it also works a treat in A, as in this setting by Geraldine Goodman (found by Gayle). My ABCs here include some of Tara Breen’s turns and some of Geraldine Goodman’s.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1lKkdgNFcmc

↳ Posted by gimpy on October 27th, 2022.

A Slip Of A Thing, X:4

Even more session friendly for some instruments, this setting in G stays mostly faithful to Tara Breen’s interpretation and sits very well on fiddle. I like it in F on fiddle for the sweetness of the key, but this tune’s lovely in any key.

↳ Posted by gimpy on October 27th, 2022.
